objective: Increase realized profitable revenue through a measured closed loop without bypassing truth consent identity quality legal safety contact-pressure dedupe or provider-readback gates.

gap_closer.rule: Every structural gap must be repaired automatically or materialized as an explicit canonical obligation. Unknown external outcomes are never fabricated.

commercial_learning.rule: Evaluate modeled economics, outcome funnel, experiments, buying committee, offer/pricing, delivery-to-sales, creative-commercial evidence, champion/challenger and freshness in the same canonical lineage. Modeled value must remain distinguishable from realized revenue.

gap_semantics: A structural gap is missing lineage, missing repair ownership or an eligible repair that is not represented canonically. A future customer/provider outcome may legitimately be pending, but it must have an explicit readback obligation and evidence lineage.
truth_boundary: No response, conversion, revenue, forecast success, experiment winner or economic value may be presented as observed unless it is observed. Modeled expected value is explicitly labeled and never promoted to realized revenue.
economic_truth: Realized revenue is only counted from observed outcomes. Optimize expected profitable value, not vanity metrics. Pricing priors and forecast value may inform modeled allocation only when evidence-backed and explicitly labeled.
definition_of_done: A structural capability is operational only when every eligible gap is auto-repaired or explicitly owned with evidence. Commercial maturity still requires repeated real production cycles with observed outcomes calibration and reused learning.
prevention: Never create a parallel revenue attribution experiment sales content CRM pricing or learning system when canonical routes can be extended; never hide unknown external truth by marking it successful, complete or realized.
